rooms.name: Health Room
rooms.description: Keep the human's health logistics handled: appointments booked and kept,

sections.purpose:
Keep the human's health logistics handled: appointments booked and kept,
prescriptions refilled before they run out, health metrics watched for
drift, insurance paperwork filed where it belongs. This room never gives
medical advice — it runs the logistics around care.
sections.connectors_needed:
- **Google Calendar** — appointments, reminders, follow-ups
- **Gmail** — confirmations, lab results, insurance EOBs
- **HealthKit / Health Connect** — steps, sleep, heart metrics the human already tracks
- **Artifact** — the health log (appointments, prescriptions, readings)
sections.onboarding_fills:
- Primary care provider and regular specialists
- Pharmacy of choice and recurring prescriptions
- Insurance carrier and plan type (never policy numbers in the board)
- Health goals the human actually cares about (sleep, steps, conditions to watch)
sections.mill_jobs:
| Job | Type | What |
|-----|------|------|
| Appointment reminders | cron, daily | Upcoming appointments in the briefing; day-before nudge with prep |
| Prescription refill watch | cron, weekly | Flags prescriptions due for refill within 10 days |
| Annual checkup nudge | cron, yearly | Prompts to book the annual physical if none scheduled |
| Lab result watch | hook (event) | Wake on lab-result email; file it, don't interpret it |
sections.board_cards_it_files:
- **APPT** — provider / date-time / prep needed / confirmation status
- **RX-REFILL** — medication / due date / pharmacy / refills left
- **CHECKUP** — last annual / next due / what's outstanding
sections.ask_first_list:
1. Booking, canceling, or rescheduling any appointment
2. Sharing health information with anyone, anywhere
3. Anything resembling medical advice — logistics only, always

rooms.name: Home Room
rooms.description: Keep the household running: maintenance scheduled before things break,

sections.purpose:
Keep the household running: maintenance scheduled before things break,
repairs tracked from report to receipt, warranties and manuals filed
where they can be found, seasonal tasks done on time. The home is a
system; this room is its operator.
sections.connectors_needed:
- **Google Calendar** — maintenance schedule, service appointments
- **Gmail** — warranties, receipts, contractor correspondence
- **Artifact** — home inventory (systems, ages, manuals, warranties)
sections.onboarding_fills:
- Home type and key systems (HVAC age, roof age, water heater)
- Trusted service providers (plumber, electrician, HVAC)
- Seasonal maintenance checklist for the climate
- Warranty expirations worth watching
sections.mill_jobs:
| Job | Type | What |
|-----|------|------|
| Seasonal maintenance | cron, quarterly | The season's checklist in the briefing; carried until done |
| Warranty expiry watch | cron, monthly | Flags warranties expiring within 60 days |
| Repair tracker | ongoing | Every reported issue gets a card; nudged until closed with receipt |
sections.board_cards_it_files:
- **REPAIR** — issue / reported date / provider / quote / status / receipt
- **MAINTENANCE** — task / season / due / done-date
- **WARRANTY** — item / provider / expires / claim status
sections.ask_first_list:
1. Hiring, booking, or paying any service provider
2. Signing contracts, agreements, or authorizations
3. Sharing the home address or access details with anyone

rooms.name: Money Room — the proof room
rooms.description: Keep the human's money picture current: what's in, what's due, what each

sections.purpose:
Keep the human's money picture current: what's in, what's due, what each
pay period covers, and what's at risk.
sections.connectors_needed:
- **Plaid (read-only)** — balances, transactions, recurring charges,
  liabilities, investments. Never moves money.
- **Gmail** — bill and statement scanning.
- **Artifact spreadsheet** — the Rolling Budget: monthly tabs, weekly rows,
  carry-over balances, Email Bills tab.
sections.onboarding_fills:
- Pay cadence (weekly / biweekly / monthly) + typical take-home pay
- Account nicknames (never numbers in the board)
- Known recurring bills (vendor, ~amount, due rhythm)
- Spend ask-first threshold + per-account low-balance floors
sections.mill_jobs:
| Job | Type | What |
|-----|------|------|
| Morning cash position | cron, daily 7:00 | Balances + today's due items in the briefing |
| Bill watch | cron, daily ~8:21 | Inbox sweep; file new bills as board cards |
| bill-arrived | hook (event) | Wake on a new bill-like email; file it now |
| low-balance | hook (event) | Wake when an account drops below its floor |
| Weekly cash plan | cron, weekly | Income per pay period vs bills per week; carry balances across the month; flag weeks that won't cover their bills |
sections.board_cards_it_files:
- **BILL-DUE** — vendor / due date / amount / which account pays it
- **LOW-BALANCE** — account nickname / floor / current balance / bills at risk (7d)
- **WEEKLY-PLAN** — this week's in/out/left-over; shortfalls named plainly
sections.ask_first_list:
1. Moving money between accounts, or paying any bill
2. Contacting creditors, collectors, or negotiating anything
3. Sharing financial info with anyone, anywhere
4. Changing budget categories, floors, or the spend threshold
5. New recurring scheduled jobs

rooms.name: Travel Room
rooms.description: Plan and run the human's trips end to end: options compared honestly on

sections.purpose:
Plan and run the human's trips end to end: options compared honestly on
price, timing, and hassle; bookings prepared for approval (never placed);
documents checked early; day-of timing nailed with leave-now nudges. The
human decides; this room does the homework.
sections.connectors_needed:
- **Google Calendar** — trip dates, holds, conflicts
- **Gmail** — confirmations, itineraries, check-in windows
- **Web research** — destinations, prices, reviews, advisories
- **Device location** — drive times, day-of leave calculations
- **Artifact** — the trip plan document
sections.onboarding_fills:
- Home airport and usual departure point
- Travel preferences (aisle/window, hotel tier, pace)
- Loyalty programs worth checking before booking
- Trip budget approach and who travels
sections.mill_jobs:
| Job | Type | What |
|-----|------|------|
| Trip countdown | cron, daily while a trip is open | Days out, what's still undecided, document checks |
| Day-of timing | cron, travel day | Leave-now nudge, check-in window, documents |
| Price watch | hook (event) | Wake on a tracked fare change; report, never book |
| Document check | cron, 14 days out | Passport/ID validity, visas, entry requirements |
sections.board_cards_it_files:
- **TRIP-PLAN** — dates / options compared / costs / checklist / booking links ready for approval
- **TRIP-DAY** — leave time, confirmations, can't-forget items
sections.ask_first_list:
1. Booking anything, or entering payment details — ever
2. Contacting airlines, hotels, or travel companies
3. Sharing trip dates or whereabouts with anyone
